stories.title: Seven killed after Thai student opens fire at home and school
stories.body: Authorities say the 14-year-old killed his grandparents before gunning down five teachers at his school.

stories.title: Spain to impose border controls against Italy as row over Ceuta migrant influx intensifies
stories.body: Italy introduced border controls following an influx of about 78,000 migrants from neighbouring Morocco into the Spanish exclave of Ceuta.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
stories.body: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.

stories.title: Spanish police arrest 78 people in bust of 'one of largest' smuggling networks
stories.body: The group moved synthetic drugs from Spain to Algeria, then used the return journey to smuggle migrants and weapons.

stories.title: Kidnapped rare Serbian eagle freed into wild after rescue
stories.body: Feliks the eagle was abducted as he first flew the nest in Serbia and wound up in the Middle East with poachers who demanded a ransom.

stories.title: Mexico and Peru restore diplomatic relations after asylum row
stories.body: Relations broke down after former Peruvian Prime Minister Betssy Chávez sought asylum in the Mexican embassy in November 2025.

stories.title: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
stories.body: The ruling is in addition to $375m in fines Meta was already ordered to pay in the case, for a total of $942m.

stories.title: Trump again tries to limit US birthright citizenship with new executive orders
stories.body: The executive orders ban birth tourism and expand the existing definition of people whose children are not eligible for US birthright citizenship.

stories.title: A new youth agitation grips an Indian state after 'cockroach' protests
stories.body: Weeks after the CJP protests shook Delhi, a new youth-led movement over jobs and recruitment is gathering force in Jharkhand.

stories.title: Trump administration to pay German firm $1.2bn to halt US wind projects
stories.body: The RWE payout is the latest in a string of deals cancelling wind energy projects, a power source long derided by Trump.

stories.title: Australian aviation crew carries out daring midwinter Antarctica rescue
stories.body: Team evacuated a patient from McMurdo Station after landing plane in total darkness and temperature of -43°C.

stories.title: Trump denies US weapons shortage and says information 'leakers' being 'hunted down'
stories.body: While precise data is classified, publicly available information suggests the US has used up many difficult-to-manufacture weapons.

stories.title: Thousands of migrants still in Ceuta after border crisis, local leader says
stories.body: The Spanish territory's mayor-president also says 100 deaths occurred as a result of 78,000 migrants crossing from neighbouring Morocco.

stories.title: South Korea space agency shares Moon images after SpaceX rocket debris crash
stories.body: Seoul's lunar orbiter captured images of the Moon before and after part of SpaceX's rocket hit its surface on Wednesday.

stories.title: Two people convicted in relation to death of French streamer
stories.body: Raphaël Graven, 46, died in August 2025, with his death live broadcast on the streaming platform Kick.

stories.title: Israel charges settler over killing of Palestinian involved in Oscar-winning West Bank film
stories.body: Yinon Levy is charged with reckless manslaughter over the July 2025 shooting of Odeh Hathaleen.

stories.title: Doge overstated claims to have saved Americans $110bn, watchdog finds
stories.body: A review of the body formerly charged with reducing government spending has found several issues with its calculations.

stories.title: German airport drone-bomb: Could Russia be involved?
stories.body: The BBC has seen evidence from previous cases that Russian-linked proxies not only handled drones and explosives, but also delivered them to Germany.

stories.title: Sudan's invisible children - born in war with no legal identity
stories.body: Babies born as a result of rape are often unable to get a birth certificate, meaning a life-time of problems.

stories.title: 'Put your phone down': K-pop band weighs in on concert etiquette
stories.body: Cortis's plea has drawn mixed reactions in a fandom that's obsessed with capturing every moment.

These developments align with a broader trajectory of governance-oriented measures aimed at asserting control amid rising global uncertainties.

**5. Watch for regulatory ripple effects and geopolitical recalibrations.**  
Key areas to monitor include potential follow-up actions against Meta by other jurisdictions, as regulatory momentum could snowball. Additionally, Spain's border controls may escalate tensions within the EU, prompting broader policy debates on migration. These signals collectively point to a cautious but active recalibration of governance and survival strategies globally.
